# Quaternius crew asset provenance

The retained professional humanoid geometry, named skeleton, skin weights and
Ranger outfit are by **Quaternius** and are dedicated under **CC0 1.0**.

- Universal Base Characters: https://quaternius.com/packs/universalbasecharacters.html
- Modular Character Outfits – Fantasy: Quaternius Standard-edition distribution
- Creator: https://quaternius.com/
- License texts: `base-license.txt` and `outfits-license.txt`
- Acquisition provenance: the source-preserving distribution in
  `OpenAgentsInc/openagents`, commit
  `0dd73f1fc61eedc25d4c96e356195641cec96627`, directory
  `assets/verse/characters/quaternius/`
- Source hashes: `upstream-manifest.json`

Dustbound removes base-body triangles hidden by clothing, disconnects the Ranger
hood, adds an original expedition cap and sunglasses, drives the original named
skeleton for locomotion, and reduces source textures to a 1024-pixel mobile
budget. Quaternius did not endorse this game or these modifications.
